proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.vehicle
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core behavior is not a passive grant, one-shot activation, triggered reaction, or simple composite. It is a persistent controllable vehicle/object with its own stat block, occupancy, sealed compartment, and action-driven control surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: To be used as a vehicle, the apparatus requires one pilot.

proposed_widenings.name: lever_control_surface
proposed_widenings.justification: The item exposes ten temporary controls whose up/down settings cause state changes, attacks, movement, lighting, vertical movement, and hatch state. Existing activation phases do not model a reusable multi-control dispatch surface over persistent object state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down.

notes: Did not author content JSON. Encoding this as passive/composite would omit the item's primary mechanics: vehicle stat block, lever-state transitions, pilot/occupant rules, and object movement/attacks.
